responses_en: Hello! 👋 Welcome AI-Powered Student Support System for BCA Admissions
responses_hinglish: Namaste! 👋 AI-Powered Student Support System for BCA Admissions mein aapka swagat hai. Main aapki madad ke liye hoon 😊 Kya help chahiye?

responses_en: The total fee for Amity Online BCA ranges from ₹2.25 Lakhs to ₹2.75 Lakhs depending on the specialization. EMI and scholarship options are also available 😊
responses_hinglish: Total fees specialization ke according ₹2.25 se ₹2.75 Lakh tak hoti hai. EMI aur scholarship options bhi available hain 😊

responses_en:
✨ Admission Process at Amity University:

1️⃣ Fill the online application form on the official Amity portal.
2️⃣ Pay the application fee (₹1,500 – non‑refundable).
3️⃣ Upload required documents: 10th & 12th mark‑sheets, ID proof, passport photo.
4️⃣ Track your status on the Admission Microsite (updates are posted there, not via email).
5️⃣ Selection is merit‑based. Students with 80%+ in 12th often get direct admission. Some PG courses may require entrance tests + interviews.

📌 Note: Admissions are currently open for UG, PG, and PhD programs. Deadlines vary by course.

For help, call the helpline [1800-102-3434](tel:18001023434) or email admissions@amityonline.com 😊
responses_hinglish:
✨ Amity University Admission Process:

1️⃣ Official Amity portal par online form fill karo.
2️⃣ Application fee pay karo (₹1,500 – non‑refundable).
3️⃣ Documents upload karo: 10th & 12th mark‑sheets, ID proof, passport photo.
4️⃣ Admission Microsite par status check karo (updates wahi milenge, email nahi aayega).
5️⃣ Selection merit‑based hota hai. Agar aapke 12th me 80%+ marks hain to direct admission mil sakta hai. Kuch PG courses me entrance test + interview bhi hota hai.

📌 Note: Admissions abhi open hain UG, PG aur PhD programs ke liye. Deadlines course ke hisaab se alag hoti hain.

Help ke liye helpline [1800-102-3434](tel:18001023434) par call karein ya admissions@amityonline.com par email bhejein 😊

responses_en: Online BCA delivers the BCA curriculum remotely using live/recorded lectures, LMS materials, and online assessments. Duration is typically 3 years.
responses_hinglish: Online BCA wahi BCA degree hai jo online mode mein padhai karwayi jati hai — live/recorded lectures aur LMS ke through. Duration 3 saal hoti hai.

responses_en: Students who have completed 10+2 from a recognized board are eligible for Online BCA.
responses_hinglish: Jo students recognized board se 10+2 pass hain wo Online BCA ke liye eligible hain.

responses_en: Required Documents: 10th & 12th Marksheet, Aadhaar Card, Passport Size Photos, and Migration Certificate.
responses_hinglish: Documents: 10th-12th marksheet, Aadhaar, photos aur Migration certificate chahiye.

responses_en:
🎉 Great news! Amity offers scholarships and fee concessions:

✅ Divyaang (Persons with Special Needs) – 20%
✅ Defence Personnel – 20%
✅ Amity University Alumni – 20%
✅ Merit-Based (85%+ Marks) – 20%
✅ Sports Scholarship (CHAMPS) – 30% to 100%

💰 Additional Discounts:
✔ Full Fee Payment – 8% to 12% Discount
✔ Annual Fee Payment – 5% Discount

responses_hinglish: Hamare paas 5 best specializations hain: Data Analytics, Cloud & Security, Software Engineering, Data Engineering aur FinTech & AI.

responses_en: The Online BCA program duration is 3 years divided into 6 semesters.
responses_hinglish: Online BCA course ki duration 3 years hai aur isme 6 semesters hote hain.

responses_en: Amity provides live online classes, recorded video lectures, digital study material, and LMS access for students.
responses_hinglish: Amity live online classes, recorded lectures, study material aur LMS access provide karta hai.

responses_en: Yes 😊 Students get internship opportunities, industry projects, and practical exposure during the course.
responses_hinglish: Haan 😊 Students ko internship opportunities aur industry projects milte hain.

responses_en: After completing BCA, students can work as Software Developers, Data Analysts, Cloud Engineers, Cybersecurity Analysts, or pursue MCA and higher studies.
responses_hinglish: BCA ke baad students Software Developer, Data Analyst, Cloud Engineer ya Cybersecurity Analyst ban sakte hain.

responses_en: Semester exams and assessments are conducted online through the Amity learning portal.
responses_hinglish: Semester exams aur assessments Amity learning portal par online conduct hote hain.

responses_en: Amity has experienced faculty members, industry experts, and dedicated academic mentors for student support.
responses_hinglish: Amity ke paas experienced faculty aur industry experts available hain.

responses_en: Amity University Online is UGC-entitled and NAAC A+ accredited.
responses_hinglish: Amity University Online UGC-approved aur NAAC A+ accredited hai.

responses_en: Online students are encouraged to attend live sessions regularly for better learning and performance.
responses_hinglish: Students ko regular live sessions attend karne ke liye encourage kiya jata hai.

responses_en: Amity provides 24×7 student support, academic guidance, technical help, and career counselling.
responses_hinglish: Amity 24×7 student support, academic guidance aur career counselling provide karta hai.

responses_en: Yes, EMI options are available for Online BCA. Students can pay fees in easy monthly installments according to university policies.
responses_hinglish: Haan 😊 Online BCA ke liye EMI option available hai. Aap fees ko easy monthly installments mein pay kar sakte hain.

responses_en: Yes, every semester has its own examinations and assessments. Students must complete exams at the end of each semester.
responses_hinglish: Haan, har semester ke end mein alag exam aur assessments hote hain. Students ko har semester ka exam dena hota hai.

responses_en: Students have shared positive experiences about the flexible learning environment, quality education, supportive faculty, and career growth opportunities at Amity Online.
responses_hinglish: Students ne flexible learning environment, quality education, supportive faculty aur career growth opportunities ke baare mein positive feedback diya hai.
